items.heading: Explains the internality and externality of the five worlds: Adam Kadmon and ABYA. And that in all twenty-five levels of each and every world there is internality and externality. And it divides the stature of each and every world. In ten discussions: — a. The internality and externality of the world of Assiya are souls and Ophanim. b. From the five Partzufim of AA, AVI, and ZON of Assiya, the NRNHY of the general soul are drawn. c. And every Partzuf of the five Partzufim of Assiya comprises NRNHY, except that the NRNHY of AA are all Yechida, and the NRNHY of Abba are all Haya, and the NRNHY of Ima are all Neshama, and those of ZA are all Ruach, and those of Nukva are all Nefesh. And the stature of Malchut in the worlds. d. In general, all the light in the world of Assiya is regarded as the light of Nefesh alone. And in particular, it has NRNHY of Nefesh, each of which comprises NRNHY, which are twenty-five levels. e. The internality and externality of Yetzira are spirits and angels, and in each of them there are five Partzufim, AA, AVI, and ZON, and in each Partzuf there are five aspects of NRNHY, namely twenty-five aspects, and they are all only the light of Ruach. And the stature of ZA in the worlds. f. The internality and externality of Beria are souls and the throne, in which are holy spirits. And in each of them there are twenty-five aspects as above. And they are all only the light of Neshama. And the stature of Bina in the worlds. g. The internality and externality of Atzilut are the essence of the light and vessels. And in each of them there are twenty-five aspects as above, and they are all the light of Haya, and the stature of Hochma in the worlds. h. The internality and externality of AK are the essence of the light, and the vessels. And in each of them there are twenty-five aspects, and they are all the light of Yechida and the stature of Keter in the worlds. i. The NRNHY in every world are internality. And the vessels in which they clothe are externality. j. All the worlds are a single Partzuf of ten Sefirot, in which AK is the Keter of them. And the world of Atzilut is Hochma. And Beria is Bina. And Yetzira is ZA. And Assiya is Malchut. And the light in all of them is internality, and the vessels in all of them are externality. And in the internality of them all is the light of Ein Sof, before which everything is externality. — The internality and externality of the world of Assiya are souls and Ophanim
items.html: *In all the worlds there is 1internality and externality; in Assiya, their externality is 2the Ophanim, and the internality is the souls. And indeed 3these souls are in the general measure.

items.heading: From the five Partzufim of AA, AVI, and ZON of Assiya, the NRNHY of the general soul are drawn
items.html: Indeed this soul divides into five aspects of NRNHY, and these five aspects are in the five Partzufim of Assiya, and they are all the Nefesh of the generality of the worlds.

items.heading: And every Partzuf of the five Partzufim of Assiya comprises NRNHY. Except that the NRNHY of AA are all Yechida. And the NRNHY of Abba are all Haya. And the NRNHY of Ima are all Neshama. And those of ZA are all Ruach. And those of Nukva are all Nefesh. And the stature of Malchut in the worlds
items.html: And so in every Partzuf of these, it has the five aspects mentioned above, NRNHY — except that these five aspects, when they are in AA, are all called Yechida of Assiya. And these five aspects that are in Abba are called Haya of Assiya. And these five aspects of Ima are all called Neshama. And these five aspects of ZA are called Ruach. And these five aspects in Nukva are called Nefesh.

items.heading: In general, all the light in the world of Assiya is regarded as the light of Nefesh alone. And in particular, it has NRNHY of Nefesh, each of which comprises NRNHY, which are twenty-five levels
items.html: And it follows that they are 4twenty-five aspects in their particulars, but in their generality, they are all only five aspects, which are the five Partzufim. And indeed, when we measure them in relation to the four worlds ABYA, they are all only the aspect of Nefesh in the general measure, and so on.

items.heading: The internality and externality of Yetzira are spirits and angels. And in each of them there are five Partzufim, AA, AVI, and ZON, and in each Partzuf there are five aspects of NRNHY, namely twenty-five aspects, and they are all only the light of Ruach. And the stature of ZA in the worlds
items.html: Similarly there are two aspects in the world of Yetzira, which are internality and externality; the internality are the spirits, and the externality are the angels. And each of these two aspects has in it five Partzufim: AA, Abba and Ima, ZA, and Nukva. And every Partzuf divides into five as above. And these are the five aspects of NRNHY that are in Yetzira, which divide into five aspects in particular as above, and into five aspects in general as above, and they are all only the aspect of Ruach, and the aspect of ZA, in the general measure of all the worlds.

items.heading: The internality and externality of Beria are souls and the throne, in which are holy spirits. And in each of them there are twenty-five aspects as above. And they are all only the light of Neshama. And the stature of Bina in the worlds
items.html: And likewise in Beria there are also two aspects, internality and externality; the internality are the souls, and the externality are the throne, in which are the holy spirits, and each divides into twenty-five aspects in particular as above, and into five aspects in general, and they are all called Neshama and Bina, in the general measure of the worlds.

items.heading: The internality and externality of Atzilut are the essence of the light and vessels. And in each of them there are twenty-five aspects as above. And they are all the light of Haya, and the stature of Hochma in the worlds
items.html: And likewise in Atzilut there are two aspects, internality and externality; the internality is the lights and the essence within it, and the externality are the vessels. And each aspect divides into twenty-five aspects in particular as above, and all of them together are the aspect of Haya and Hochma, in the general measure of the worlds.

items.heading: The internality and externality of AK are the essence of the light, and the vessels, in each of which there are twenty-five aspects, and they are all the light of Yechida and the stature of Keter in the worlds
items.html: And likewise in Adam Kadmon there are two aspects, internality and externality; the internality is the essence within it, and the externality are the vessels, although in relation to the rest of the worlds they are not yet called vessels, but only in relation to its own internality do we call them by the name vessels. And in each of them are all the aspects mentioned above, and in their generality they are called Yechida and Keter, in the general measure of all the worlds. And this is what is stated at the beginning of Tikkun 70, 'AK is the supernal Keter,' and so on.

items.heading: The NRNHY in every world are internality. And the vessels in which they clothe are externality
items.html: And know that all the internal aspects that are in each and every one of these five worlds are: the aspect of Yechida, Haya, Neshama, Ruach, Nefesh, in that world itself. And its externality are the vessels and the body, within which clothe: the Yechida, Haya, Neshama, Ruach, and Nefesh.

items.heading: All the worlds are a single Partzuf of ten Sefirot, in which AK is the Keter of them. And the world of Atzilut is Hochma. And Beria is Bina. And Yetzira is ZA. And Assiya is Malchut. And the light in all of them is internality, and the vessels in all of them are externality. And in the internality of them all is the light of Ein Sof, before which everything is externality
items.html: It follows now 5that all the worlds are the aspect of a single Partzuf, of ten Sefirot alone. And Adam Kadmon, in all its aspects, is the Keter among them; and Atzilut is the Abba among them; and Beria is the Ima among them; and Yetzira is the ZA among them; and Assiya is the Nukva among them; and they are all one single Partzuf. And there is the essence, which is the internality, and the vessels, which are the externality, and within all of them is the light of Ein Sof, in relation to which they are all called vessels and externality alone, while it alone is, within them, the essence and internality.
